title: Multiple Defects
text:
Multiple Defects. At two separate places on the outside of the top ceramic section, there are defects, as you can see from the pictures. And at the underside of the cup, there is permanent white paint all over.

The paint job is terrible along the rim. Also there is an imperfection inside the cup where the ceramic looks bad.

I received a refund from Amazon. I do not recommend this cup at all.
